segments.title: 第180章 誰是小丑?
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 180: Who's the Clown?

A little over half an hour later, it was already eleven o'clock at night.

Li Luo chuckled and picked up the lipstick Xu Youyu had prepared, drawing an "o" on Ying Chanxi's delicate cheek.

At this point, Li Luo had already drawn a tic-tac-toe grid on Ying Chanxi's right cheek, and the "o" he had just drawn fit right in the middle of it.

It seemed they were playing tic-tac-toe.

"You have such a wicked sense of humor." From the side, Xu Youyu squinted at Li Luo, the tic-tac-toe grid on her left cheek also just one stroke away from being complete.

After finishing his drawing on Ying Chanxi's face, Li Luo chuckled and looked at Xu Youyu. "Senior, it's your turn."

"Hmph, hurry up!" Xu Youyu pushed her cheek forward, allowing Li Luo to successfully complete the tic-tac-toe game.

After the punishment for this round was over, Ying Chanxi puffed her cheeks indignantly and started to shuffle the cards.

Beside them, Xu Youyu was even more unconvinced. "What kind of luck is this? How can you win every single hand?"

They had played seven or eight hands in a row, and this guy Li Luo hadn't lost a single one.

In half of those games, he even won as the Landlord, beating both of them and drawing a stroke on each of their faces.

"How can you call this luck? I didn't even have a joker in my hand just now, but didn't I still win in the end?" Li Luo raised his eyebrows and said, "This is called skill, you understand?"

"Again! I refuse to believe it." Xu Youyu cracked her knuckles, vowing to win a round against Li Luo to avenge the tic-tac-toe game drawn on her face.

Unfortunately, Li Luo never really gave them a chance.

With the help of his memory palace, he was basically a perfect card counter. Moreover, based on the cards they played, he could use his memory palace to analyze and deduce what cards they likely had left in their hands.

Under such circumstances, it was hard for him not to win.

For Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu, if they had truly wanted to learn how to count and analyze cards, their intelligence would have actually allowed them to contend with Li Luo.

However, they were just playing for fun and had no intention of using their brains too much, so how could they know that this guy Li Luo was secretly cheating?

The three of them played cards and ate snacks, with a TV drama playing in the living room.

As the time gradually approached midnight, the tic-tac-toe games on one side of Ying Chanxi's and Xu Youyu's faces were already completely filled in.

Li Luo then started working on the other side of their cheeks, drawing a little pig on Ying Chanxi's and a little turtle on Xu Youyu's.

It wasn't until the very last deck that Li Luo's conscience finally kicked in. After deliberately bidding for the Landlord position, he threw the game and lost.

The moment Xu Youyu played her last card, she instantly leaped up from the sofa, cheering and jumping for joy in the living room.

"I won, I won! I finally won!"

Xu Youyu high-fived Ying Chanxi. The two of them were so overcome with joy they almost cried, hugging each other to enjoy the sweetness of victory.

"Hand over the lipstick!" Once her excitement had calmed down, Xu Youyu snatched the lipstick that hadn't left Li Luo's side all night. She smiled at him, humming to herself, and no one knew what she was plotting.

"Ahem…"

At first, Li Luo was just a little embarrassed, having won the entire night. That's why he decided to go easy on them at the end.

But seeing Xu Youyu's malicious look, Li Luo subconsciously stood up from the sofa, wanting to escape.

But in the next second, Xu Youyu pushed Li Luo back down onto the sofa and shouted to Ying Chanxi, "Chanxi, come here! Hold him down, don't let this kid run away!"

"Coming, coming!" Ying Chanxi had also been holding in a bellyful of frustration from losing to Li Luo all night. She immediately ran over and pressed half her body onto Li Luo, preventing him from moving.

"Hey, hey… when will this cycle of revenge ever end?" Pinned down by Ying Chanxi, his shoulders held firmly, Li Luo had no chance of escape. He could only say with an awkward smile, "Senior, go easy on me. We still have to go set off fireworks, let's not waste any more time."

"No rush, there are still ten minutes left." Xu Youyu smiled at Li Luo, gesturing in mid-air with the lipstick as if considering what to draw on his face. "You just sit there quietly and leave the rest to me."

After saying that, Xu Youyu fell into a contemplative state, thinking about what to draw on Li Luo.

Seeing she had no intention of letting him go, Li Luo switched his target and patted Ying Chanxi, who was half-pressed against him.

"I won't run. I'm a good sport, so you don't have to hold me down."

"I don't believe you," Ying Chanxi said with a huff. "It's not like you never cheated when we were little. We'll see after Senior finishes drawing on you."

At this moment, Ying Chanxi had one foot on the floor and the other on the sofa, with her knee kneeling beside Li Luo. Her small hands were pressing on his shoulders, with most of her upper body leaning in front of him.

Being in such close proximity made Ying Chanxi's face blush slightly.

However, Li Luo just assumed it was because she had gotten too excited while playing cards. That, plus the bottle of beer she had finished, made it understandable that his little childhood friend was a bit tipsy.

In contrast, he and Xu Youyu were less restrained.

Over the course of more than an hour, Xu Youyu had downed four or five bottles of beer. Li Luo had accompanied her with three cans, but he didn't feel drunk, just more mentally active at most.

And Xu Youyu acted as if nothing was wrong, looking like she secretly drank quite often.

From what Li Luo knew about her, ever since she started writing web novels, Xu Youyu would almost always have a little drink whenever she had writer's block. Once she entered that slightly tipsy state, inspiration would flow out like a mountain spring.

It was more or less the same this time.

After a moment's thought, Xu Youyu, emboldened by the alcohol, grinned as she opened the lipstick cap. Standing behind Ying Chanxi, she moved closer to Li Luo's face.

Watching the lipstick get closer and closer, Li Luo closed his eyes as if accepting his fate. Then he felt the lipstick in Xu Youyu's hand begin to move across his face.

And it wasn't just on his cheeks; it included the corners of his eyes… In the end, even his lips weren't spared.

Ying Chanxi, pressing down on Li Luo, watched with great interest as Xu Youyu drew on his face. The more she watched, the more she wanted to laugh.

But when she saw Xu Youyu applying the lipstick to Li Luo's lips, Ying Chanxi's expression froze for a moment. Then she reminded her in a low voice, "Senior, you're still going to use this lipstick, right? To put it on his mouth like that, is- isn't that a little inappropriate?"

"It's fine." Xu Youyu waved her hand. "I've barely used this lipstick. I don't really have many occasions to wear it anyway. From now on, I'll just use it specifically for card game punishments."

She had only bought this lipstick because she wanted to describe the feeling of applying it in her novel.

After trying it once for the experience, she had never used it again.

This counted as putting it to good use.

After hearing what Xu Youyu said, Ying Chanxi breathed a small sigh of relief and then continued to admire Li Luo's face.

At this point, Li Luo's lips had been colored bright red, and Xu Youyu had extended the corners of his mouth, drawing two upward-curving arcs.

On his cheeks, she had drawn two bright red circles, and the tip of his nose was also colored red.

She even used the lipstick to draw eyeliner at the corners of his eyes, making them sweep slightly upward.

At a glance, it was a very comical clown makeup.

"Hahahaha," Xu Youyu was very satisfied with her work. After the masterpiece was complete, she finally couldn't help but burst out laughing.

After looking for a few moments, Ying Chanxi couldn't hold it in either, leaning against Li Luo and shaking with laughter.

Li Luo opened his eyes with a look of resignation and sighed, patting Ying Chanxi's shoulder. "Satisfied now? Once you're done, let's go wash our faces and get ready to go downstairs for the fireworks."

"What's your hurry?" After climbing off him, Ying Chanxi said with a grin, "You're not allowed to wash it off yet. I'm going to get the camera."

Li Luo: "...?"

A moment later, Ying Chanxi returned with the Polaroid camera Li Luo had given her. She then pulled Xu Youyu and Li Luo to sit on the sofa, one on each side of her.

"Get ready, time for pictures."

After finding several good angles, Ying Chanxi took a few group photos in a row, capturing their "disgraceful states" at that moment, before nodding in satisfaction.

"I knew I should have drawn something else on you two." Li Luo looked at his own work on their faces and sighed with a click of his tongue. "I was too gentle."

"Heh," Xu Youyu snorted coldly. "Someone won so many hands earlier, and the way he held the lipstick didn't look gentle at all. That smug smile on his face, I remember it clearly."

"Alright, alright." Li Luo coughed twice and stood up from the sofa. "The new year is almost here. Let's wash our faces and get ready to go downstairs."

"Do we need to clean this up?" Xu Youyu asked, looking at the beer cans and snack bags scattered all over the floor.

"We can clean it up tomorrow," Li Luo said. "The most important thing today is to have fun."

With that, Li Luo went back to his room to wash his face.

Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu also went into the bathroom in the hallway.

A few minutes later, the three of them, with clean faces, grabbed the fireworks Li Luo had bought and prepared to go downstairs.

Watching Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu quickly change into thick sweaters and down jackets, putting on thermal pants and trousers, and assembling at the door in just two or three minutes, Li Luo fell into deep thought.

"So if we were going to set off fireworks, you two were going to change and come downstairs anyway, right?" The corner of Li Luo's mouth couldn't help but twitch. "So why didn't you two just come with me when I went down to buy things earlier?"

"Ahem." Xu Youyu patted Li Luo's shoulder. "Sometimes, you know, it's better not to think things through too clearly. Ignorance is bliss, it's the only way to get by, don't you think?"

"Let's go." After wrapping a scarf around herself, Ying Chanxi grabbed Li Luo's scarf from the sofa and helped put it on him. "Don't get caught up in these things. You said it yourself, the most important thing today is to have fun."

Li Luo gave a couple of flat laughs. "You two have really said it all, haven't you?"

(End of Chapter)
